spans.s: gandhakuṭī (EI 9, 18; IA 14), originally, ‘a chamber for the Buddha's use’; later ‘the chamber enshrining the Buddha image in a monastery’; a shrine where the image of the Buddha is worshipped; a Buddhist temple.
gandha-śāli (EI 5), a kind of rice or paddy.
Ganeśa-homa (EI 26), a rite; same as Vināyaka-homa.
gānī, cf. aṭha-gānī, a billon coin equal to 8 copper jitals and to (1/6) of a silver ṭaṅka (JNSI, Vol. XII, p. 198); cf. jītal.
gānī , cf. aṭha-gānī, billon coin equal to 8 copper jitals and to (1/6) of a silver ṭaṅka.

gandhahasti-māḍa^1 , same as gandhavāraṇa-māḍa; probably, ‘māḍa bearing the figure of an elephant in rut’; see māḍa.
[1] Correction submitted by Dhaval Patel on 20160121. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/243. note: sh.
